Ada: open, balance 0
  Command.Deposit { amount: 100 } -> Ada: open, balance 100
  Command.Withdraw { amount: 250 } refused: cannot withdraw 250 with a balance of 100
  Command.Freeze { reason: "suspicious activity" } -> Ada: frozen (suspicious activity)
  Command.Withdraw { amount: 10 } refused: the account is frozen: suspicious activity
  Command.Unfreeze -> Ada: open, balance 100
  Command.Close refused: withdraw the remaining 100 first
  Command.Withdraw { amount: 100 } -> Ada: open, balance 0
  Command.Close -> Ada: closed
  Command.Deposit { amount: 5 } refused: Ada's account is closed
Ada: closed
